If the code under test reads reviewer_trial (haiku) scorer cost from `_dispatch_tool`'s result, this stub yields zero cost and the test can pass without ever verifying that the scorer cost is actually accumulated into TrialReport totals — a potential false negative for the very feature (task 1030) being tested.

task.title: Include reviewer_trial scorer (haiku) cost in TrialReport totals
task.description:
orchestrator/src/orchestrator/evals/reviewer_trial/scorer.py::match_issues() calls invoke_agent(model='haiku', max_budget_usd=0.50) and receives result.cost_usd, but the cost is discarded. ScoringResult.cost_usd (scorer.py:300) is populated only from run.total_cost_usd (the reviewer-panel cost). TrialReport.total_cost_usd (report.py:204) sums just these panel costs.

Impact: 5 variants × 15 diffs = 75 scorer invocations × up to $0.50 each = up to $37.50 silently omitted from cost metrics and f1_per_dollar rankings — the exact metric this trial is built to measure. Cost-based variant comparisons are under-reported.

Fix:
- scorer.py:182 match_issues() — return (matches, unmatched, match_cost_usd).
- scorer.py:~300 score_panel_run — accumulate match_cost into ScoringResult (new field match_cost_usd, or fold into cost_usd with a doc note).
- report.py:204 TrialReport.total_cost_usd — sum the new field.
- Update any tests that assert cost-field shape.

Locations: orchestrator/src/orchestrator/evals/reviewer_trial/{scorer.py, report.py}.
